recipe_definitions.snapshots: g0/g1 XY grid from row%3 and floor(row/3)%3; g>=2 shifts X one grid step. IDs are100+row before g2 and1000+row after. attribute=2*(row mod6). g0..g3/g7 all active; g4..g6 rows0..7 inactive.
recipe_definitions.matrix: active rows only, 48 sources; each active target row has coefficient1 at source (row+g) mod48 and zero elsewhere; all source flags zero.
recipe_definitions.energy: one nonzero sample at sample=row. Normally old/new amplitude1. At g2 even rows old1/new1/1024, odd rows old1/1024/new1.
recipe_definitions.reader_gate: g<2 marker/history only; g>=2 performs Type11 encode/decode, reader56 materialization and target generation.

encoding.bytes: ASCII tag B || U64LE byte_length || exactly byte_length payload octets
encoding.bool: ASCII tag Z || U8 value, where false=0 and true=1
encoding.int: ASCII tag I || I64LE two's-complement value
encoding.tuple_or_list: ASCII tag T || U64LE element_count || encode_node(element[0]) || ... || encode_node(element[count-1])
encoding.dataclass: ASCII tag D || U16LE class_name_ascii_byte_length || class_name ASCII bytes || U16LE declared_field_count || each declared field in dataclasses.fields order as U16LE field_name_ascii_byte_length || field_name ASCII bytes || encode_node(field_value)
encoding.framing: No NUL terminators, alignment padding, separators or trailing bytes occur. Every nested node begins immediately after the previous node and carries its own tag and length/count framing.
encoding.field_order: Exactly the order listed by whole_state.fields recursively; names and values are both serialized.

mutation.meaning: delivered component code6 reaches selected Type11 adapter
